args.title: Halvorsen Supply: Warehouse automation in 2026 (article + companion)
args.body:
- Halvorsen Supply's latest newsletter covers "Warehouse automation in 2026"; the linked article reports that pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts.
- The same article notes a key caveat: integration took twice as long as planned.
- The companion piece (matched to project SANDPIPER) adds that the biggest saving from automation was fewer mis-picks.
